sources_note: Imported from the research handover by tools/import_handover.js. CONFIRMED = official OEM or government document; BUILDER_MEASURED = measured by a body builder on a built vehicle (dimensioned layout drawing), between CONFIRMED and ESTIMATED; ESTIMATED = planning value, derived figure or non-official source; UNKNOWN = not found (value null). Interior dimensions are design estimates, not measurements (data/handover/rv_handover_part1_models_data_research/data/interior_confidence_report.md).

living_x0_from_rear.method: Living area starts 40 mm wall + 20 mm inside the rear face (xr = xB + t + 0.02)

usable_length.method: GLB living length: from 60 mm inside the rear wall to 360 mm behind the cab-seat backs (cab length estimated: vans 1650–1800 ±250 mm, buses 2100–2600 ±300 mm). Not a measurement.

usable_width.source: Azad Automotive Customs, "Voyager VIP on Force Urbania" (WB 4400), dimensioned top-view layouts, PDF pages 2–3, Oct 2026; data/reference/builders/azad_voyager-vip_urbania-4400_oct-2026.pdf
usable_width.method: Revised default: exterior width 2245 × 78.8 %, the finished-width ratio measured by Azad Automotive Customs on the Urbania 4400 (1651 / 2095). Not measured on this vehicle.

expected_error.text: −50/+150 mm (ratio from one Urbania build; bare-panel widths can be about 150 mm more, e.g. the Force Traveller cargo leaflet gives 1680 mm on a 1925 mm body)

alt_estimates.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
alt_estimates.method: Exterior width 2245 − 2 × 40 mm assumed wall (donors.json shellWallEachSideMm 40 ±15). No taper, trim or tumblehome allowed for.

expected_error.text: −200/+30 mm (Force delivery-van leaflet shows 1680 mm cargo width on the 1925 mm Traveller body, i.e. up to ~165 mm less than this estimate)

standing_height.method: GLB living-area clear height = overall height 2850 − estimated floor 580 − 40 mm roof skin − 20 mm (build_camper.py: zc = H − t − 0.02)

floor_height.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
floor_height.method: Not published. Planning default from donors.json (vans 560 ±100 mm, Wider Body 580) / concept floor for bus bodies (LP 410 900 ±150, Eicher 950 ±150, Viking 1000 ±200)

wheel_arch.note: Interior intrusion is NOT modelled in the GLB layouts (the arches are cut only in the body side walls). Values below are donors.json planning defaults, not measurements.

intrusion_from_each_side_wall.method: donors.json planning default interior.wheelArchIntrusionMm (tyre size known, housing not)

side.method: Kerb (left) side, as modelled in the GLB

from_front.method: Converted from the handover x-from-front-axle: front overhang − x

to_front.method: Converted from the handover x-from-front-axle: front overhang − x

height.method: GLB placeholder: from sill to 150 mm below roof

glb.origin: Mid-length of the body, on the centreline, at ground level. NOT the front axle and NOT the repo origin (rear bumper). Repo x (mm from rear bumper) = (glb_x_m + L/2) × 1000.
glb.layout_as_built: fixed rear transverse double bed 2165x1400 mm over a storage garage; wet room with cassette toilet, shower tray and washbasin; kitchenette 1300 mm with 2-burner cooktop and sink, 12 V fridge; dinette 1700x1300 mm (2 facing benches + removable table, converts to a 2nd bed); tall wardrobe; overhead lockers; water tank 173 L, 1 x 100 Ah LiFePO4 battery + panel, 230 V shore inlet, 2 x 2 kg extinguishers (driver + kitchen/door)
